description: This is a 3D model of a tall, narrow cabinet with a light wood finish. It features two doors on the upper section, one of which is slightly ajar, revealing an interior shelf. The cabinet has a single drawer at the bottom, which is partially pulled out. The drawer has a small, round, dark knob. A distinctive orange handle is attached to the right-hand upper door. The overall design appears to be simple and functional, suggesting it could be part of a modular furniture set or a standalone storage unit.
